title: ProteinGPT: Multimodal LLM for Protein Property Prediction and Structure Understanding

model.params_source: assumed (paper silent; o3-mini snapshot by the alias rule; reasoning effort default)

task.subset_rule: seeded random 35 proteins (seed 20260907) from the released 160-protein test split, all their 28-30 questions (about 1,025)
task.approximation: different 35-protein sample than the paper's; prompt assembly (system line + FASTA record + question) taken from the Appendix D.2 example; o3-mini reasoning effort unstated

items.source: https://github.com/OviaLabs/ProteinGPT (redirect of ProteinGPT/ProteinGPT), folder src/data (ProteinQA, RCSB-PDB derived); test split of 160 proteins x 28-30 QA pairs
items.license: unknown (repository LICENSE file present, contents not checked)

fields_prose.input: question + FASTA sequence of the protein (from RCSB PDB if not shipped)
fields_prose.label: reference answer

prompt.system: You are an expert in protein domain, please answer the questions given the protein primary sequence and only give a concise answer to the question.

placeholders.fasta_record: FASTA header + sequence fetched from RCSB PDB (not expressible)
placeholders.question: items.question

prompt.source_location: Sec. 4.2.3 (FASTA sequence prepended to the prompt); wording from Appendix D.2 (o3-mini example: system prompt, protein sequence information, question)
prompt.verbatim: partial (the system line is printed in Appendix D.2; the order 'FASTA record then question' follows Sec. 4.2.3 and D.2, exact separators assumed)

placeholders_prose.fasta_record: FASTA header line ('>{pdb_id}_1|Chain A|{name}|{organism}') followed by the primary sequence
placeholders_prose.question: items.question

output.postprocess: strip; ROUGE-L F1 against the reference answer (rouge_score, default tokenisation)

metric.name: rouge_l
metric.definition: mean ROUGE-L F1 between the model answer and the reference answer over the sampled questions
metric.original_location: Table 4, row OpenAI o3-mini, column R-L

open_points: the repository README describes ProteinQA (132,092 proteins) and a src/data folder but no explicit test-split file; confirm the QA file and split after cloning, otherwise the item source is missing
ROUGE implementation (the paper cites 'Rouge 2.0', Ganesan 2018) may differ from rouge_score

item source missing: the repository (OviaLabs/ProteinGPT, main) contains code only; src/data/DATASET.md is a one-line acknowledgement and no ProteinQA test-split file is released there, so items.file_url cannot be set
runner gap: the FASTA record must be fetched per protein from RCSB PDB
notes: Baseline row of a fine-tuned-model paper; set-level comparison against a differently sampled 35-protein subset. Sequences add ~300 input tokens per call.
